# Awesome-LLM-Compression: offline papers

[Original catalogue](https://github.com/HuangOwen/Awesome-LLM-Compression) · [Upstream snapshot](upstream/README.md)

Paper files live in the direction directories below. Existing method-local papers
are reused. Entries appearing in more than one upstream category point to one file.
[papers.json](papers.json) lists original URLs, file locations relative to the
quant-docs root, and download availability. Unavailable entries retain their original links.

- [Surveys](../../surveys/papers/README.md)
- [Quantization](../../quantization/papers/README.md)
- [Pruning and sparsity](../../pruning/papers/README.md)
- [Distillation](../../distillation/papers/README.md)
- [Prompt compression](../../prompt-compression/papers/README.md)
- [KV cache compression](../../state-compression/papers/README.md)
- [Other approaches](../../other-compression/papers/README.md)

Titles, years and categories follow the upstream catalogue; inclusion does not
establish novelty, effectiveness or compatibility. Task restrictions take precedence,
including fixed evaluation inputs and any ban on speculative decoding.

Snapshot retrieved 2026-10-01: 1080 entries have offline PDF and TXT; 4 remain unavailable (source access failed). See `papers.json` for per-entry status and alternate public sources.
